task_name: Constructive Falsification Experiment for the Lawful-Disambiguation Dichotomy

construction_attempts.name: recipe_space_composition_identification_at_tested_scale
construction_attempts.evidence: Task A1-B004 (ADR-0049): heuristic beam search, zero oracle primitive identity, bank size 8, max_depth<=3 (raw bound 584 candidates), 99.62% mean exact match (threshold >=85%), 99.93% functional agreement, zero bank expansion, N=32 adaptation set.

construction_attempts.name: recipe_space_pushed_past_any_fixed_budget
construction_attempts.evidence: Largest bank scale ever exercised: N=128 (Task A2-C004, ADR-0065). 128^3 ~= 2.1e6, trivially enumerable; m^k > 1e12 requires depth >=6, never used or authorized; single-workstation/no-architecture-search invariant (AGENTS.md) forbids manufacturing such scale as a default experiment.

construction_attempts.name: argument_space_combinatorial_blowup
construction_attempts.evidence: ADR-0031 (A1-R005D-002): SHIFT/COUNT/BIND argument domains are range(10), bucketed <=32 embedding rows, injective; joint 2-argument combinations reach at most ~100 combinations, already exhaustively audited as routine verification.

construction_attempts.name: deliberately_hard_cryptographic_style_composition_target
construction_attempts.evidence: No registered primitive (SHIFT/SELECT/COUNT/BIND/MIRROR_HALVES/NEIGHBOR_MAX) has cryptographic one-wayness or average-case hardness; manufacturing this requires a new, unauthorized primitive family, itself an unregistered relation subject to the same 2-of-4 inventory deficit as NRQ-001's N2.

bounded_resource_corollary.claim: For any finite composition of the currently registered, non-cryptographic, structurally-pruneable APC primitives, evaluated at any in-scope scale, the Lawful-Disambiguation Dichotomy's Case B holds without the tractability caveat: the disambiguating function g remains tractable to state and is already empirically stated and baseline-dominant (A1-B004).
